sutra_text_index.8.2.42: रदाभ्यां निष्ठातो नः पूर्वस्य च दः
sutra_text_index.1.1.61: प्रत्ययस्य लुक्श्लुलुपः - oral final ओ-vowel of upadeśa is conventionally lost

unique_dhatus.marker: ṭvit, ñit, anunāsika ओँ on ओ

corrections.note: Original pipeline cited 7.2.10 (एकाच उपदेशेऽनुदात्तात्). Corrected to 7.2.14 (श्वीदितः) — the proper reason for भिदिँर् being इदित्.
Original pipeline incorrectly invoked 7.3.84 guṇa here, producing वेपर् + अथु → वेपरथु, which is wrong. There is no vowel in वेप् to gunate.
ङ्-it of ङीप् strictly by convention (ङीप् is sup-vidhāyaka, not taddhita); Vṛttikāra cites paribhāṣā.
भञ्जो's final ओ is anubandha-vowel marker (anudāttet/ovacarga); lost upon dhātu-grahaṇa.
घ् not strictly in चु/टु; treated as anubandha by nomenclature ('घ' embedded in 'घुरच्' to mark it as घित्).
Audit removed erroneous 6.1.97 step from original pipeline; यच्छ् ends in छ् (consonant), no अ-ekādeśa applies between यच्छ् and अ.
Original cited 1.3.2 (anunāsika) for डु; correct sūtra is 1.3.5 (ādir-ñiṭuḍavaḥ).
Sūtra is 6.1.135 in standard numbering; some editions show 6.1.134.
Original pipeline omitted explicit 6.1.97 pararūpa step; added per audit.
Audit added 6.1.77 yaṇ + 1.2.5 kit step explicitly.
Original cited 7.3.33; correct is 7.3.37 (which lists पा explicitly).
Original cited 1.3.5 for ड्; correct is 1.3.7 (चुटू covers ṭu-class incl. ड्).
More precisely: इ (mātrā in upadeśa) and च् are it; net surface is स्.
Original cited 1.3.91 (दुयुद्भ्यो लुङि); correct sūtra is 1.3.92 (वृद्भ्यः स्यसनोः) since context is लृङ्/लृट् with स्य.

steps.logic: Root भिदिँर् from Rudhādi-gaṇa (7) is designated as a dhātu.
steps.logic_hindi: रुधादिगण की धातु भिदिँर् को धातुसंज्ञा।

steps.logic: The final consonant र् of भिदिँर् is designated as it.
steps.logic_hindi: भिदिँर् का अन्त्य र् हलन्त्यम् से इत्संज्ञक।

steps.logic: The anunāsika vowel इँ in upadeśa is designated as it. This makes the dhātu इदित् for purposes of 7.2.14.
steps.logic_hindi: उपदेश में अनुनासिक इँ की इत्संज्ञा। अतः धातु इदित् (इत्संज्ञक इकारवाली)।

steps.logic: The it-marked sounds (इँ and र्) are elided. Surviving form: भिद्.
steps.logic_hindi: इत्संज्ञकों (इँ और र्) का लोप। शेष भिद्।

steps.logic: क्त (= क्त-niṣṭhā) suffix is introduced after the dhātu in past-tense sense.
steps.logic_hindi: धातु से परे भूतकाल अर्थ में क्त प्रत्यय। (निष्ठा-संज्ञा अधिकार)

steps.logic: The initial क् of क्त is designated as it (in non-taddhita context). This makes क्त कित्.
steps.logic_hindi: अतद्धित प्रत्यय क्त के आदि क् की इत्संज्ञा। क्त कित् हुआ।

steps.logic: Elision of क् (it-marker). Suffix becomes त.
steps.logic_hindi: क् का लोप। प्रत्यय अब त।

steps.logic: iṭ-augment proposed by 7.2.35 (vala-ādi ārdhadhātuka त) is BLOCKED by 7.2.14, since भिदिँर् is इदित् and the suffix is निष्ठा.
steps.logic_hindi: 7.2.35 से इट् आगम प्राप्त, परन्तु इदित् धातु + निष्ठा होने से 7.2.14 (श्वीदितो निष्ठायाम्) से इट्-निषेध।
steps.audit_correction: Original pipeline cited 7.2.10 (एकाच उपदेशेऽनुदात्तात्). Corrected to 7.2.14 (श्वीदितः) — the proper reason for भिदिँर् being इदित्.

sutras.text_deva: रदाभ्यां निष्ठातो नः पूर्वस्य च दः

steps.logic: After र्/द् of dhātu, the त् of niṣṭhā → न; AND the द् of dhātu → न. Two simultaneous substitutions: द्→न् and त→न.
steps.logic_hindi: र्/द्-अन्त धातु से परे निष्ठा के त् को न्, तथा पूर्व के द् को भी न्। द्→न्, त→न।
सुँ का स् → रु (रुत्व) → विसर्ग। अन्तिम रूप: भिन्नः।

audit_notes: Original cited 7.2.10 for iṭ-niṣedha; corrected to 7.2.14 (श्वीदितो निष्ठायाम्), the proper rule for इदित् roots in निष्ठा.
Added explicit step splitting हलन्त्यम् (1.3.3 for र्) from उपदेशेऽजनुनासिक इत् (1.3.2 for इँ).
All steps respect the v2 invariant: SAMJNA/IT_SAMJNA/BLOCKED do not change form; LOPA/ADESHA/SANDHI do change form.

steps.logic: Initial ञि is it (1.3.5); final आँ (anunāsika) is it (1.3.2).
steps.logic_hindi: आदि ञि एवं अन्त्य अनुनासिक आँ की इत्संज्ञा।

steps.logic: क् of क्त is it (1.3.8) and elided. Result: त.
steps.logic_hindi: क्त का क् इत्संज्ञक होकर लोप। शेष त।

steps.logic: iṭ-augment blocked: धृष् is monosyllabic (एकाच्) and anudāttet.
Dental त adjacent to retroflex ष is replaced by retroflex ट (ṣṭutva).
steps.logic_hindi: ष् के योग में दन्त्य त् को मूर्धन्य ट् आदेश (ष्टुत्व)।

audit_notes: Original pipeline correct in essentials. Refined: explicit splitting of ṭi marker steps; identified ñit explicitly via 1.3.5.

steps.logic: Initial ञि is it (1.3.5); final आँ is it (1.3.2). The dhātu thus carries the ādit property (relevant for 7.2.14 if treated as one of श्वीदित् class).

steps.logic_hindi: धातु के आदि ष् को स् आदेश।

steps.logic: iṭ blocked: ñiṣvidā̃ counts as ādit/ī-dit class root with niṣṭhā suffix.
steps.logic_hindi: ष्विदाँ श्वीदित्-गण में होने से निष्ठा में इट्-निषेध।

sutras.text_deva: रदाभ्यां निष्ठातो नः पूर्वस्य च दः

steps.logic: Dual substitution: द्→न् and त→न after द-final dhātu before niṣṭhā.
steps.logic_hindi: द्-अन्त धातु से परे निष्ठा-त को न् और पूर्व द् को भी न्।

steps.logic: सुँ added; uँ as it elided → स्.
steps.logic_hindi: सुँ। उँ की इत्संज्ञा होकर लोप।

audit_notes: OCR mentioned 'स्विष्णः' (corrupted). The correct form for this dhātu is स्विन्नः, derived as above.
iṭ-niṣedha: cited 7.2.14 — applicable since ñiṣvidā̃ is included in the श्वीदित्-class for निष्ठा.

steps.logic: Initial ञि is it; final ईँ (anunāsika) is it. The īdit property is established.
steps.logic_hindi: ञि एवं अनुनासिक ईँ की इत्संज्ञा। धातु ईदित्।

steps.logic: iṭ blocked because इन्धीँ is ईदित्.
steps.logic_hindi: ईदित् धातु निष्ठा परे रहने पर इट्-निषेध।

steps.logic: Penultimate न् of consonant-final non-इदित् dhātu is elided before kit/ngit suffix. क्त is कित्. इन्धीँ is not इदित् (it is ईदित्). So न् elided.
steps.logic_hindi: अनिदित्, हलन्त, उपधा-नकार-वाली धातु से क्ङित् प्रत्यय परे रहते उपधा-नकार का लोप। इन्ध् → इध्।

steps.logic: After झष् consonant (here ध्), त्/थ् → ध (when not in pada-end before जश्).
steps.logic_hindi: झष्-वर्ण ध् के परे रहने पर निष्ठा-त को ध आदेश।

steps.logic: झल् consonant ध् → जश् equivalent द् before झश् (the second ध).
steps.logic_hindi: झश् ध के परे झल् ध् को जश् द् आदेश।

audit_notes: Added explicit iṭ-niṣedha step (7.2.14) which the original implicitly skipped.
Confirmed 6.4.24 applicability: इन्धीँ is ईदित् not इदित्, so anidit condition holds.

pratyaya.name: अथुच्
pratyaya.purpose: bhāva, formed only after ṭvit roots

steps.logic: Initial टु and final ऋँ are it. The dhātu becomes ट्वित्.
steps.logic_hindi: आदि टु एवं अन्त्य ऋँ की इत्संज्ञा। धातु ट्वित्।

steps.logic: Both it-markers elided. Surviving form: वेप् (the ऋ as anunāsika is itself it, hence elided entirely; only वेप् remains).
steps.logic_hindi: टु एवं ऋँ का लोप। शेष वेप्।

steps.logic: After a ṭvit dhātu, अथुच् suffix is introduced (in bhāva sense).
Final च् of अथुच् is it.
Elision of च्. Suffix becomes अथु.
Phonetic combination. वेप् ends in प्, अथु begins with अ. Direct concatenation. NO guṇa/vṛddhi needed since वेप् has no final vowel to gunate (the ऋ is it, already elided).
steps.logic_hindi: वर्ण संयोग। वेप् + अथु = वेपथु। कोई गुण आवश्यक नहीं क्योंकि ऋ इत्संज्ञक होकर लुप्त हो गया।
steps.audit_correction: Original pipeline incorrectly invoked 7.3.84 guṇa here, producing वेपर् + अथु → वेपरथु, which is wrong. There is no vowel in वेप् to gunate.

audit_notes: MAJOR CORRECTION: Original pipeline had a spurious guṇa step (7.3.84) producing वेपर् + अथु. Removed because the ऋ in टुवेपृँ is anunāsika (1.3.2 it) and elided entirely; only वेप् remains, with no vowel to gunate.

dhatu.marker: ṭvit, ñit, anunāsika ओँ on ओ

steps.logic_hindi: टु, ओँ का लोप। शेष श्वि।

steps.logic: Final इ of dhātu श्वि → guṇa = ए before ārdhadhātuka अथु.
steps.logic_hindi: श्वि के अन्त्य इ को आर्धधातुक अथु परे रहते गुण ए।
ए को अच् परे रहते अय् आदेश।

audit_notes: Here guṇa IS applicable (श्वि ends in vowel इ which gunates). Contrast with वेपथुः where the ऋ was already itself elided as anunāsika.

target.meaning: that which is made by cooking

pratyaya.name: क्त्रि (+ मम् augment)
pratyaya.purpose: denotes 'that which is made by [the action]'

steps.logic: Initial डु it (1.3.5); final ष् it (1.3.3); अँ on पच (anunāsika) it (1.3.2). The dhātu is ḍvit.
steps.logic_hindi: आदि डु, अन्त्य ष्, मध्य अँ की इत्संज्ञा। धातु डित्।

steps.logic: क्त्रि is added after ḍvit dhātu.
मम् augment is obligatorily appended to क्त्रि.
steps.logic_hindi: क्त्रि के बाद नित्य मम् आगम।

steps.logic: क् of क्त्रि is it; elided. क्त्रि is कित्.
steps.logic_hindi: क्त्रि का क् इत्संज्ञक होकर लोप। क्त्रिम कित्।

steps.logic: च् of पच् → क् (kavarga) before झल् (त्). Most-similar substitute: ज् → ग्ग, च् → क्.
steps.logic_hindi: च् को कवर्ग आदेश। पच् → पक्।

steps.logic: After neuter prātipadika ending in अ, सुँ → अम्.
steps.logic_hindi: अकारान्त नपुंसक से सुँ को अम् आदेश।

steps.logic: अ + अ (of अम्) → single अ (pūrvarūpa ekādeśa).
steps.logic_hindi: अकार + अम् के अकार का पूर्वरूप एकादेश।

audit_notes: Original pipeline collapsed steps 5 and 6 into one. Separated मम् augment from क्त्रि → क्त्रिम step for clarity.

steps.logic: Initial डु, final ञ् are it.
क् of क्त्रि it elided. क्त्रि is कित्.
Guṇa of ऋ would normally occur (7.3.84), but क्त्रिम is कित् (since क्त्रि was क्), so 1.1.5 blocks guṇa.
steps.logic_hindi: क्त्रिम कित् होने से 1.1.5 से गुण-निषेध।

audit_notes: Note: The OCR original mentioned 'डह्ज धातु' (corrupted) which was correctly identified as डुकृञ्.
Added explicit BLOCKED step for guṇa-niṣedha; the kit-marker on क्त्रिम blocks guṇa of ऋ.

target.meaning: that which is grown by sowing

steps.logic: Initial डु, final अँ are it.
क् it elided. क्त्रिम is कित्.

Saṃprasāraṇa: For roots वच्, स्वप्, यज्ādi (which includes वप्), the semivowel व् of the dhātu is replaced by its corresponding vowel उ, when a kit suffix follows. क्त्रिम is कित्. Result: व् → उ. So वप् → उप्.
steps.logic_hindi: वच्, स्वप्, यजादि (जिसमें वप् भी है) धातुओं को कित् प्रत्यय परे रहते सम्प्रसारण होता है। व् → उ। वप् → उप्।

audit_notes: OCR mentioned 'उप्त्रिमम्' but with garbled wording ('उप्विमम्'). The correct form is उप्त्रिमम्.
Added the saṃprasāraṇa step explicitly via 6.1.15 — the OCR mentioned this rule but the previous pipeline omitted it.

target.meaning: young descendant of Kuñja (gotrāpatya then yuvāpatya)

steps.logic: कुञ्ज is meaningful, non-dhātu, non-pratyaya → prātipadika.
ṣaṣṭhī ekavacana ङस् provisionally added (in semantic sense 'of Kuñja') to host च्फञ्.
Kuñjādi-gaṇa member → च्फञ् taddhita for gotrāpatya sense.
Initial च् of च्फञ् is it (cuṭū applies to the initial cu-/ṭu-class consonant of a pratyaya).
steps.logic_hindi: च्फञ् के आदि च् की इत्-संज्ञा।

steps.logic: Final ञ् of च्फञ् is it.
Both it-markers (च्, ञ्) elided → फ remains.
steps.logic_hindi: च्, ञ् दोनों का लोप → फ शेष।

steps.logic: Initial फ of pratyaya replaced by आयन्.
च्फञ् had ञ्-it (ञित् pratyaya) → ādi-ac of aṅga (उ in कुञ्ज) → vṛddhi औ.
steps.logic_hindi: ञित् प्रत्यय परक → आदि अच् उ → वृद्धि औ।

steps.logic: Bha-saṃjñaka अङ्ग कौञ्ज + अजादि-pratyaya → final अ of कौञ्ज elided.
steps.logic_hindi: कौञ्ज का अन्त्य अ लोप → कौञ्जायन।

steps.logic: कौञ्जायन is read in Gargādi-gaṇa → yuvāpatya in यञ्.
Final ञ् of यञ् is it.
Bha-saṃjñaka कौञ्जायन + अजादि य → final अ elided.

steps.logic_hindi: स् → रु → विसर्ग। अन्तिम रूप कौञ्जायन्यः।

target.meaning: one whose abode/origin is in the Śāṇḍika country

steps.logic: Śaṇḍikādi-gaṇa member → ञ्य taddhita in 'tatra bhavaḥ' sense.
Aggregate prātipadika → internal sup सुँ luk.
ञ् of ञ्य is it (it would be ādi-ञ् here; but Pāṇini's reading ञ्य treats ञ् as initial it of pratyaya → 1.3.3 final-hal applies vacuously; convention: ञ्-anubandha by 1.3.3 since ञ् in upadeśa).
ञित् pratyaya → ādi-ac अ of शण्डिक → vṛddhi आ.
Final अ of शाण्डिक elided before अजादि य.
Initial ज् of जस् is it.
Initial ट् of टा is it.

sutras.text_deva: no further pada-end transformation: च् not pada-final, no consonant cluster

target.meaning: she who roams in the Kuru land (upapada-samāsa, fem.)

steps.logic: चर् is dhātu; कुरु+सup (saptamī) is upapada.
ट pratyaya after चर् in upapada compound.
steps.logic_hindi: उपपद-समास में चर् से ट प्रत्यय।

steps.logic: Initial ट् of ट is it.
ङ् (initial), प् (final) of ङीप् are it. (Note: ङ् not in चु/टु/ल/श/क्व; here treated by paribhāṣā/convention since ङीप् is not taddhita; some Vṛttis cite 1.3.5 आदिर्ञिटुडवः-extension or paribhāṣā.)
steps.audit_correction: ङ्-it of ङीप् strictly by convention (ङीप् is sup-vidhāyaka, not taddhita); Vṛttikāra cites paribhāṣā.

steps.logic: Bha-saṃjñaka अङ्ग कुरुचर + अजादि ई → final अ elided.

steps.logic_hindi: दीर्घ ई-अन्त स्त्री → सुँ लोप। कुरुचरी सिद्ध।

steps.logic: Anunāsika अँ of जनँ → it → लोप; ड pratyaya added. [atomized step 1/2 of original compound: IT_SAMJNA + LOPA]
Anunāsika अँ of जनँ → it → लोप; ड pratyaya added. [atomized step 2/2 of original compound: IT_SAMJNA + LOPA]
Final ड् of ड is it.
ḍ-pratyaya is ḍit → 'टि' part (अन्) of जन् elided by sāmarthya-vārttika.
Final ञ् of चिञ् is it.
ल्युट् after dhātu in bhāva sense.
Initial ल् and final ट् of ल्युट् are it.
यु → अन (युवोरनाकौ: यु replaced by अन).
इ of चि → guṇa ए before ārdhadhātuka अन.
Napuṃsaka अकारान्त + सुँ → सुँ replaced by अम्.
steps.logic_hindi: नपुंसक अकारान्त → सुँ का अम् आदेश।

steps.logic: अ + अम् → पूर्वरूप एकादेश अम् (अ retained).

sutras.text_deva: प्रत्ययस्य लुक्श्लुलुपः - oral final ओ-vowel of upadeśa is conventionally lost

steps.logic: Upadeśa final ओ (anubandha-vowel) drops in surface; remainder भञ्ज्.
steps.audit_correction: भञ्जो's final ओ is anubandha-vowel marker (anudāttet/ovacarga); lost upon dhātu-grahaṇa.

steps.logic: Initial घ् of घुरच्? घ् is not in cu-/ṭu-class. By convention/traditional reading, घ् here is anubandha-by-name (the घ् of घुरच् signals घित् for 7.3.52). Some commentators read 1.3.7 broadly.
steps.audit_correction: घ् not strictly in चु/टु; treated as anubandha by nomenclature ('घ' embedded in 'घुरच्' to mark it as घित्).

steps.logic: Final च् of घुरच् is it.
घित् pratyaya परक → ज् of भञ्ज् → kavarga: closest is ग् (both are voiced, unaspirated, sa-sthāna by 1.1.50). Also ञ् → ङ् (homorganic nasal).
लट् is ṭit → ti-bhāga (अ) of त → ए.
steps.logic_hindi: टित् लट् → त के टि (अ) को ए। आस्ते सिद्ध।

steps.logic: Initial डु of upadeśa is it.
Final ञ् of upadeśa is it.
